s.how: Cut 500g white fish into bites, crumb and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve with lemon and tartare. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Toast 16 marshmallows on skewers until golden. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 plain biscuits and squash together. Serve while the chocolate is melting.

m.how: Season a 1.5kg rump steak and grill 6 minutes a side, then rest 10 minutes. Slice and serve with 1kg roast potatoes, salad and bread.

w.how: Toss 800g blueberries with 120g sugar and cornflour, fill a pastry case, top and bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve with ice cream. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Chill 8 bottles of lager and serve. Lemonade for the kids. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
